question: This test should pass when no error is shown, but it fails. Why?
options: getByText throws before expect can check
say: This test should pass when no error is shown, but it fails. Why?
explanation: getBy throws as soon as nothing matches, so expect never runs. Use queryByText, which returns null, to assert that something is absent.
explainSay: Get by text throws when nothing matches, so the expect never runs. Use query by text instead.
